title: 狐联

series.next: The sisters never visited again. You've been practising couplets ever since.

setting: 元宵 night, long ago. The whole town is out guessing lantern riddles. You've stayed in your study with your books.

dajie.name: 大姐
dajie.en: the elder fox sister: sets riddles, never loses

xiaomei.name: 小妹
xiaomei.en: the younger fox sister: laughs at everything, kindly

steps.narr: 元宵 night. Lanterns in every street, and riddles hung from every lantern. You stay in your study, reading.
Two young women at your door, each with a lantern. Their shadows on the wall have pointed ears.

steps.zh: 外面都在猜灯谜，您怎么一个人在读书？
steps.en: Everyone's out guessing lantern riddles. Why are you here reading on your own?

say.en: Receive them formally: please be seated, and forgive your humble rooms.
answers: 二位请坐，寒舍简陋，见笑了。
say.gloss: Please, both of you, sit. My poor rooms are very plain: forgive me.
say.tip: 寒舍 hánshè = 'my cold house': the modest word for your own home. 见笑了 = you'll laugh at me (forgive me).

fail.en: Won't you ask us to sit?

4.gloss: Please, both of you, sit. Forgive the place.

steps.zh: 我们不白坐。出个对子，您对上了，我们就走。
steps.en: We don't sit for nothing. I'll give you half a couplet. Match it, and we'll go.

steps.narr: She dips a brush, and writes the first line in one stroke of the wrist.
steps.zh: 戊戌同体，腹中只欠一点。
戊戌同体，腹中只欠一点。请对下联。
steps.en: 戊 and 戌 share one body; only the belly lacks a stroke. Your line, please.

say.en: Try an answer of your own: 甲 and 由 share a body too, but one stroke pokes out at the top.
answers: 甲由同体，头上多出一竖。
say.gloss: 甲 and 由 share one body; up top, one stroke sticks out.
say.tip: Her riddle: 戊 and 戌 look alike, but 戌 has one more stroke inside, 'in the belly'. Yours: 甲 and 由 look alike, but 由's middle stroke pokes out at the top. 竖 shù = a vertical stroke.

ok.en: Shame it isn't a strict match.

4.gloss: 甲 and 由 share one body.

steps.zh: 上联讲肚子，下联也得讲身上。还得一样长。
steps.en: The first line's about the belly; yours must be about the body too. And just as long.

say.en: Concede gracefully: you can't match it, and you admire it.
answers: 学生才疏学浅，对不上，佩服佩服。
say.gloss: My learning is thin. I can't match it. I'm full of admiration.
say.tip: 才疏学浅 = little talent, shallow learning: the scholar's modest shrug. 佩服佩服 = I admire it, said twice.

ok.en: Then I'll match it for you.

ok.narr: She writes the second line beside the first.
ok.zh: 己巳连踪，足下何不双挑。
己巳连踪，足下何不双挑。
ok.en: 己 and 巳 walk in step; at the foot, why not both flick up?

fail.en: If you can't match it, admit it.

4.gloss: I can't match it. I'm full of admiration.

steps.narr: 戊 and 戌 share a body; 戌 has one stroke more in the belly. 己 and 巳 walk side by side; at the foot, both strokes flick upward, 双挑. And 足下, 'at the foot', is also an old polite word for 'you'.

steps.zh: 姐姐太难为人了！换个容易的。
steps.en: Sister, that's too hard on anyone! Give an easier one.
Very well. 'Heaven adds months and years; people add long life.'

say.en: Concede with grace, or match the easier line.
answers: 二位才高八斗，学生甘拜下风。
say.gloss: You two have talent to spare. I bow to you.
say.tip: 甘拜下风 = gladly bow from downwind: I admit you're better.

ok.zh: 知道自己对不上，也是学问。
ok.en: Knowing what you can't match is learning too.

alts.en: Or: match it: spring fills heaven and earth, and luck fills the door
answers: 春满乾坤福满门，请二位指教。
alts.gloss: 'Spring fills heaven and earth; luck fills the house.' Your verdict?

then.zh: 这是门上贴的。算您会找。
then.en: That one's pasted on every door in town. Still, credit for finding it.

fail.en: Heaven adds months and years; people add long life.

alts.gloss: 'Spring fills heaven and earth; luck fills the house.'
alts.tip: 增 pairs with 满, 岁月 with 乾坤, 人 with 福, 寿 with 门: the 春联 on half the doors in China.

steps.narr: They're gone, lanterns and all. On your desk, a sheet of red paper, with the couplet in a hand you've never seen.

steps.en: The sisters never visited again. You've been practising couplets ever since. 🏮

else.en: The sisters never visited again. You pasted their red paper on your door, and you've been practising couplets ever since. 🏮
